organization.name: Digital GrowthScale
organization.description: Digital GrowthScale designs intelligent operating systems that let businesses scale without depending on founders.

local_business.name: Digital GrowthScale
local_business.description: Digital GrowthScale helps founders, CEOs, and growing teams integrate intelligent automation, CRM, remote staffing, recruitment, and lead generation into one connected growth system.

service.name: Corporate Learning, AI Literacy & Productivity Training
service.description: The future of work is already here. Is your team ready for it?

mainEntity.name: Do participants need any technical background?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Workshops are designed to be non-technical and business-friendly for employees, managers, and leaders alike.

mainEntity.name: Can training be delivered onsite or virtually?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we run onsite, hybrid, and fully virtual workshops depending on what works for your team.

mainEntity.name: How large can the cohort be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Workshop cohorts typically range from 20 to 300 participants, and can be scaled further for larger organizations.

mainEntity.name: Can content be customized to our industry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, use cases and examples are tailored to your team's actual workflows and industry context.

mainEntity.name: Is this a one-time workshop or ongoing training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both formats are available, from a single session to a structured, multi-part training program.

service.name: CRM, Funnel & Lead Generation Systems
service.description: Your pipeline should work even when you are not watching it.

mainEntity.name: What if we already use a CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can work within your existing CRM or rebuild the pipeline structure if it's not capturing or tracking leads properly.

mainEntity.name: Do you write the follow-up messaging too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we design the nurture sequences and follow-up messaging alongside the automation itself.

mainEntity.name: How fast can this go live?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most core pipeline and follow-up systems can be live within a few weeks, depending on complexity.

mainEntity.name: Will this work with our current ad and social channels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we connect lead capture from Meta ads, LinkedIn, referrals, and events into the same pipeline.

mainEntity.name: Is this only for high-ticket offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It works especially well for high-ticket and appointment-based businesses, but fits any business with real lead volume to manage.

service.name: Finance, Legal, Compliance & HR Operations Support
service.description: Stay organized, compliant, and operationally ready.

mainEntity.name: Do you replace our finance, legal, or HR staff?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We provide organized back-office support and coordination that complements your existing team, not a replacement for it.

mainEntity.name: What kind of documents can you help organize?

acceptedAnswer.text: Employee files, contracts, policies, compliance calendars, HR templates, disciplinary documentation, and onboarding and offboarding records, among others.

mainEntity.name: Is this only for companies with compliance problems already?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It's just as valuable for companies preparing for growth, audits, expansion, or restructuring, before problems appear.

mainEntity.name: Can you support payroll coordination directly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we help keep payroll processes organized, accurate, and on schedule as part of this service.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with businesses outside the Philippines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we support Philippines-based SMEs as well as global businesses with Philippine operations or remote teams.

service.name: Business Growth Operating System Setup
service.description: Your business needs more than hustle. It needs a system.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from the Business Growth Systems Audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The audit diagnoses where the gaps are. This service builds the actual operating system — SOPs, dashboards, and accountability structure — to close them.

mainEntity.name: Will this slow the team down with more process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The goal is the opposite. Clear systems remove the back-and-forth and guesswork that actually slow teams down today.

mainEntity.name: Do you build the tools, or just the documents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. We design the SOPs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and set them up in the tools your team already uses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a full setup take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary by team size and number of departments involved, typically a few weeks to a couple of months.

mainEntity.name: Is this only relevant once we're already big?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It's most valuable while you're still small enough to build the system right, before disorganization becomes harder to unwind.

service.name: Business Growth Systems Audit
service.description: Find exactly where your business is losing time, leads, and revenue.

mainEntity.name: What exactly happens during the audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: We review your sales, operations, staffing, marketing, finance, HR, and reporting systems, interview key people where needed, and map how work actually flows through the business today.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most engagements run one to three weeks, depending on the size of the business and how many functions we're reviewing.

mainEntity.name: What do we walk away with?

acceptedAnswer.text: A clear, prioritized action plan and roadmap that shows exactly where time, leads, and revenue are being lost, and what to fix first.

mainEntity.name: Do we have to commit to further services afterward?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The audit stands on its own. Many clients use it to decide which of our other services, if any, make sense next.

mainEntity.name: Is this only for larger companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It's built for founder-led and operator-led businesses of most sizes, from lean teams to organizations with a couple hundred people.

service.name: AI Automation & Digital Transformation Consulting
service.description: Stop doing manually what a system can do consistently.

mainEntity.name: Do we need technical staff to make this work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We handle the technical setup and design workflows your non-technical team can run day to day.

mainEntity.name: Which processes should we automate first?

acceptedAnswer.text: We start by identifying the workflows costing the most time and causing the most errors, then prioritize from there.

mainEntity.name: Will this replace our team?

acceptedAnswer.text: The goal is to remove repetitive manual work so your team can focus on higher-value tasks, not to replace people.

mainEntity.name: What tools do you work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work with what you already have — GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HRIS platforms, CRMs, and more — and recommend additions only where genuinely needed.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from just buying software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Software alone doesn't fix broken workflows. We design the process first, then implement the automation around it.

service.name: Recruitment, Executive Search & Talent Mapping
service.description: The roles that matter most deserve more than a job post.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a regular recruiter?

acceptedAnswer.text: We focus on strategic search and talent mapping for business-critical roles, not just forwarding resumes from job boards.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of roles do you specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadership, specialized, confidential, and hard-to-fill roles across executive, sales, operations, finance, HR, compliance, and technical functions.

mainEntity.name: Can you help us figure out the role before we post it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, talent mapping and market intelligence are often done before a role is even opened, to inform salary, title, and scope.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle confidential searches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, confidential and sensitive searches are part of what this service is built for.

mainEntity.name: How long does an executive search typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies by role seniority and market, but we prioritize speed without compromising the quality of the shortlist.

service.name: Outsourcing & Remote Staffing Solutions
service.description: Skilled. Reliable. Remote. Ready to grow with you.

mainEntity.name: What roles can you help us staff?

acceptedAnswer.text: VAs, executive assistants, appointment setters, SDRs, customer support, finance assistants, HR assistants, recruiters, content support, graphic design, and operations coordinators, among others.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a staffing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stay involved beyond placement, supporting onboarding, expectation-setting, and performance so the hire actually works out.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can we bring someone on?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines depend on the role, but most positions can be sourced, screened, and onboarded within a few weeks.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle payroll and compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Staffing and onboarding are handled through this service; for deeper HR, payroll, and compliance coordination, that's covered under our Finance, Legal, Compliance & HR Operations Support service.

mainEntity.name: Can we replace a hire if it's not working out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we support continuity if a role needs to be re-filled, including for unexpected resignations.
